messages:
Rhea: quick find from the console review — header chips push the action icons down on narrow widths and toasts briefly overlap the header during save. thinking: collapse chips into a single overflow chip at <=360px instead of wrapping, and move compact toasts to bottom-left.
Dmitri: agree on collapse. overflow should be keyboard accessible and announce how many filters are active (e.g., '3 active filters').
Hannah: accessibility nit: when chips collapse, ensure the overflow chip has an accessible name distinct from visual +N label. aria-label='Show active filters (3)'. Also keep focus ring visible on the collapsed chip.
Ola: small CSS proposal:
```
.header.compact .chips { display: none; }
.header.compact .chips-overflow { display: inline-flex; min-width: 48px; }
.dashboard.compact .toast-container { bottom: 16px; left: 16px; right: auto; }
```
Rhea: love the snippet. also microcopy: use "Active filters" in the overflow menu header rather than just "Filters" so it's clear it's stateful.
Dmitri: check table rows with inline controls — collapsing chips shifts layout. we should reserve the header height to avoid jump: `.header { min-height: var(--header-compact-h); }` and fade chips instead of reflowing.
Hannah: design-lint-bot, quick contrast + focus check on proposed chip styles?
design-lint-bot: accessibility scan complete. Contrast for chip text on proposed bg = 4.7:1 (AA). Focus ring visible at 2px on compact. Recommendation: add aria-live='polite' to toasts and trap focus inside overflow menu when opened. :white_check_mark:
Ola: OK — i'll update figma with +N overflow chip, aria-label, min-height to header, move compact toasts to bottom-left, and add keyboard trap note. i'll post the figma link here when done.
Rhea: thanks! small change but should reduce layout jank and improve discoverability. :thumbsup:
